clue.text: Not yielding, soldiers made smaller advances

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, are soldiers
advances as a loan: money advanced is lent
smaller means less

explanation.surface: Stubborn troops make only modest gains as they push forward.
explanation.walkthrough: The charade runs in answer order, not clue order: LENT (advances) comes before LESS (smaller); 'made' just joins.
explanation.definitionFit: Relentless describes something that never lets up or gives way, a synonym of unyielding.

clue.text: It may be called a cylinder

explanation.surface: Something summoned might be tube-shaped.
explanation.definitionFit: A roll is a register of names that is called, and a roll is also anything wound into a cylindrical shape.

clue.text: A form of security on the river

explanation.surface: A safety measure used by the waterside.
explanation.definitionFit: A lock fastens a door for safety, and a lock is also a gated chamber for raising and lowering boats on a waterway.

clue.text: Reputation on the way down for such boasting

parts.note: a good name is a reputation
dropping means falling, on the way down

explanation.surface: Someone's standing slips, which is what showing off can do.
explanation.definitionFit: Name-dropping is the boastful habit of mentioning famous acquaintances to impress.

clue.text: Measure of wine at first readily swallowed by the, French.

indicators.note: swallowed by means the wine and letter go inside the French article

parts.note: le is French for the
It is short for Italian vermouth, as in gin and It

indicators.note: at first takes the opening letter of readily

explanation.surface: A quantity of wine is quickly downed by the French.
explanation.walkthrough: IT for Italian vermouth is an old crossword staple; IT plus R goes inside LE.
explanation.definitionFit: A litre is a metric unit of volume, a measure.

clue.text: Curt greeting associated 'with broadcasters

parts.note: curt means short and abrupt
a wave of the hand is a greeting

explanation.surface: A brusque hello from people who work in radio.
explanation.definitionFit: Shortwave is a radio band used for long-distance transmission, so it describes radio stations' signals.

clue.text: First-class return to this place

indicators.note: return asks for the word for first-class to be read backwards

parts.note: tops is slang for first-class, the best

explanation.surface: A top-quality trip back to here.
explanation.definitionFit: A spot is a place, so 'this place' can be named by the noun.

clue.text: Extremely efficient corporal repairs coffee-maker

indicators.note: repairs means the letters are put back together in a new order
extremely gives the outer letters, first and last, of efficient

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A very capable army corporal fixes the coffee machine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Extremely' takes E and T, the first and last letters of 'efficient'; 'repairs' shuffles them with CORPORAL.
explanation.definitionFit: A percolator brews coffee by cycling boiling water through ground beans.

clue.text: A small part you used once, also in the south

parts.note: thou is the old form of you

indicators.note: in places the word for also between the two pieces that follow

parts.note: th' is the elided form of the in old poetry
and means also

explanation.surface: A fraction that someone archaically called theirs, and also found in the south.
explanation.walkthrough: AND sits between S and TH, a poetic clipping of 'the' as in th' end.
explanation.definitionFit: A thousandth is one of a thousand equal portions, a tiny fraction.

clue.text: Vulgar disturbance reported in movement

indicators.note: reported means the phrase for a vulgar disturbance is spoken rather than written

parts.note: vulgar means low, a disturbance is a commotion: low commotion

explanation.surface: A coarse ruckus is said to have broken out during a political movement.
explanation.definitionFit: Locomotion is the act or power of moving from place to place.

clue.text: A group written to about religious instruction

indicators.note: about here means going round, so to wraps the abbreviation

parts.note: taken as written
RI is the school abbreviation for religious instruction

explanation.surface: A party sends a letter to someone regarding scripture lessons.
explanation.walkthrough: 'written' is surface colour: the plain word TO goes round RI.
explanation.definitionFit: A trio is a set of three performers or things, a small group.

clue.text: Theatre employee seen in river after coach run?:

indicators.note: after says the river's letter follows the coach and run words

parts.note: a stagecoach, or stage, is a coach
to run a business is to manage it
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: Someone from a theatre spotted by a river after a coach trip.
explanation.definitionFit: A stage manager organises the backstage running of a theatrical production.

clue.text: Chance to visit a nude resort.

indicators.note: resort read as re-sort, sorting the letters again into a new order

explanation.surface: An invitation to visit a naturist holiday camp.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' looks like the holiday place but is re-sort, the anagram signal for TOVISITANUDE.
explanation.definitionFit: Adventitious means happening by accident, so it fits chance used as an adjective, as in a chance meeting.

clue.text: Uriah mishit 'second at the first, causing hitch:

indicators.note: at the first puts the abbreviation for second at the very front

parts.note: Uriah Heep is the scheming clerk in Dickens's David Copperfield
to shank is to mishit a golf ball off the club's heel

explanation.surface: Uriah fluffs his second shot at the first hole and causes a problem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Uriah' points to the Dickens villain Heep; a shank is a golf mishit.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheepshank is a knot for shortening rope, and a hitch is a type of knot.

clue.text: Professional investigator raised it over the defence

parts.note: pro is short for professional
tec is slang for a detective

indicators.note: raised in a down clue means the word it is turned upward, read bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written
on can mean over, as in on top of

explanation.surface: A private eye lifted it above the defensive line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns IT into TI in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Protection is a means of guarding or keeping safe, the same as a defence.

clue.text: Handel and Rossini overtures a girl played on this?

indicators.note: overtures are openings, so the first letter of each of the three words is taken

parts.note: Monica is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl performs openings by two great composers on some instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A harmonica is a mouth organ, an instrument that a person plays.

clue.text: One isn't a corrupt goddess, though unappeasable

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: corrupt means spoilt or garbled, so the letters of the words are rearranged

parts.note: Ate is the Greek goddess of mischief and ruin

explanation.surface: Someone isn't a debauched deity, though impossible to satisfy.
explanation.definitionFit: Insatiate means never satisfied, a synonym of impossible to appease.

clue.text: Smallest possible quantity of cereal

explanation.surface: The tiniest amount of breakfast food.
explanation.definitionFit: A grain is a tiny particle or the least amount of something, and also the seed of a cereal crop such as wheat.

clue.text: Bar giving some beverages to patrons

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A pub serving drinks to its regulars.
explanation.definitionFit: Estop is a legal term meaning to prevent or preclude, the verb sense of bar.

clue.text: Small animal chewed up, beam inside this vessel

indicators.note: inside places the rearranged letters within the animal's name

parts.note: a stoat is a small animal of the weasel family

indicators.note: something chewed up is mangled, so the letters of beam are rearranged

explanation.surface: A little creature gnaws a wooden beam aboard a boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chewed up' turns BEAM into EAMB, and 'inside' puts that within STOAT.
explanation.definitionFit: A steamboat is a boat driven by steam power, a type of vessel.

clue.text: Sounds like sister's supporter is '.without equal!

indicators.note: sounds like says a phrase for the sister's supporter is heard, not seen

parts.note: a nun is a religious sister, and a second to a nun backs her up

explanation.surface: Someone who backs up a sister is unrivalled.
explanation.walkthrough: A second is an assistant, as in a duel or boxing; 'second to nun' is heard as the idiom.
explanation.definitionFit: Second to none is an idiom for the very best, unmatched by anyone.

clue.text: Narcissus at first needed help capturing a nymph

indicators.note: at first takes the opening letter of Narcissus
capturing means the word for help holds the a inside it

parts.note: aid means help

explanation.surface: Narcissus needed assistance to catch a water spirit.
explanation.walkthrough: Narcissus, the youth of Greek myth, was loved by the nymph Echo, which makes the surface apt.
explanation.definitionFit: A naiad is a water nymph of Greek mythology.

clue.text: Therefore proceed, after some hesitation

indicators.note: after says the word for proceed follows the hesitation sound

parts.note: er is the sound of someone hesitating
go means proceed

explanation.surface: So, carry on, after a moment's pause.
explanation.definitionFit: Ergo is Latin for consequently, used in English to mean hence.

clue.text: Dreadful kid's undergarment, a sort 'of shirt

parts.note: a bra is an undergarment
a T-shirt is a sort of shirt

explanation.surface: An awful child's underwear and a type of top.
explanation.definitionFit: A brat is a badly behaved child.

clue.text: Alliance, whose, vehicles don't start

indicators.note: don't start means the first letter of the word for vehicles is dropped

parts.note: taxis are vehicles

explanation.surface: A partnership whose cars won't start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'don't start' removes the T from TAXIS.
explanation.definitionFit: The Axis was the wartime alliance of Germany, Italy and Japan, so an axis is a political pact.

clue.text: Real germ disorder about in his case? No

definitions.text: Real germ disorder about in his case? No

indicators.note: about here means going round, so the scrambled letters surround the small word
putting the letters into disorder rearranges them

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Does this shirker really have a germ-caused illness? No.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disorder' turns REALGERM into MALGERER, which goes 'about' IN. As a whole the clue says there is no real disorder in this person's case.
explanation.definitionFit: A malingerer feigns illness to avoid work, so a genuine disorder is precisely what such a shirker lacks.

clue.text: Family disposed to do good to others

definitions.text: disposed to do good to others

explanation.surface: Relatives inclined to be generous.
explanation.definitionFit: Kind means a family or sort, as in humankind, and also benevolent and considerate.

clue.text: Nurse employed by the infantry is a newcomer

parts.note: a tender is one who tends, or nurses
foot soldiers are the infantry, often called simply the foot

explanation.surface: A nurse taken on by the army is new to the job.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenderfoot is a novice or raw beginner, originally a new arrival in the frontier West.
